ReleaseNotes:
Version 4.0.5

New Features:
• Add ElbowToSiphon: pick pipe elbows one after another and replace each one with a siphon, using the family and type chosen in SiphonSetting.
• Add a Room Info tab to ProjectInfo: every placed room in the model and in loaded Revit links, with Select in Model and zoom to the room.
• Add ViewportWork: move viewports, change the viewport type, apply view templates and pin / unpin viewports on many sheets from one window.
• Add SheetList: export the sheet list in Project Browser order to Excel (.xlsx) or CSV.
• Add ResetCrop: set crop region lines back to their default color, pattern and weight (the undo of OverrideCrop).
• Add CombineText: combine the selected text notes into one text note, in reading order.
• Add SplitText: split multi-line text notes into one text note per line.
• Add RoomTag: tag the rooms of linked models and / or the current model in many plan views at once.

Improvements:
• FamilyByCad: place hosted families - face-based families (also on ceilings, walls and floors of linked models) and wall / ceiling / floor / roof-hosted families.
• SheetCreator: WithActiveView, ViewPerSheet, MultiViewsSheet, ByCadFile and EmptySheet are combined into one command.
• SheetNumber: new comprehensive window - sheets in Project Browser folders, renumber by sheet, sequence or find / replace, live preview, and confirm the changes before renumbering in Revit.
• AI (formerly Claude Connect): the most powerful version yet - more than 100 tools to read and edit the model, read CAD and PDF files, draw pipes / ducts and riser diagrams, place families, rename and run AI-written scripts; connects to Claude Desktop, Claude Code, VS Code (GitHub Copilot), Cursor, Windsurf, Antigravity, Gemini CLI, Cline and Kiro.

Version 3.3.3

New Features & Improvements:
• Update ProjectInfo: add SheetInfo, ViewInfo, ViewTemplateInfo, and LevelInfo.
• Add X, Y position for viewports and an auto-generate sheet feature in ViewPerSheet.
• Add X, Y position for WithActiveView.

• Add more information to CadWork.
• Upgrade ExportCad: create single CAD files using a configured naming convention.

Bug Fixes:
• Fix ShowAll bug when unchecking the checkbox.

Version 3.0.6

New Features & Improvements:
• Add new feature: ShowAll — show everything on the active view via Temporary View Properties, with Select New (selects newly created elements, expands the plan View Range or shows them in a 3D view) and Toggle Temporary View (flips Temporary View Properties on the active view).
• Add new feature: CopyFromLink — pick a Revit link and copy Grids, Levels, and family-based building elements (columns, framing, floors) from the link into the host document.
• Move the update check to Revit exit — no more update popup at startup; when a new version is available you are asked once while closing Revit and it installs automatically after Revit closes.

Version 3.0.3

New Features & Improvements:
• Update RotateElements: no longer requires picking a pipe to define the rotation axis.
• Add new feature: PerpenConnect2.
• Add new feature: SiphonSetting.

Version 2.8.3

New Features & Improvements:
• Add PerpenConnect2: pick main + branch, the command locates the branch's true nearest connector, projects that connector onto main (projectionPoint1), projects projectionPoint1 back onto the branch axis (projectionPoint2), slides projectionPoint2 back along the branch axis by the perpendicular offset (newPoint), then relocates the branch's near end to newPoint and bridges the gap with a new pipe joined to main via a Tee and to the branch via an Elbow. Branch slope is preserved by keeping the far-end connector verbatim. In the TeeConnect pulldown, between PerpenConnect and CrossConnect.

Version 2.8.2

New Features & Improvements:
• Add GroupManager to filter, browse, and open views containing the selected groups.
• Add Arrange to align and evenly space pipes, ducts, cable trays, or conduits by center or outer skin.
• Rework OwnerElements as a standalone tool with select-and-zoom actions for owner and last-changed-by elements.
• Upgrade SearchElements with dynamic parameter columns (filter and remove on the fly).
• Improve CheckClash navigation, item details, and reliability.
• Fix FamilyByCad: CAD link no longer imported, block placement now uses Revit geometry, and symbol-name matching is rotation- and scale-independent.

UI & Ribbon:
• Reorganize the Document panel: grouped CreateSheet / SheetNumber / WorkOnSheet, and Create3D / OpenInPlan / Crop stacks.
• Unify window color and style across SearchElements, WhoCreated, OwnerElements, GroupManager, and CadWork.

Version 2.7.3

New Features & Improvements:
• Add new commands: FamilyByCad, CadWork, and the Tag/Text leader-matching pair: Match Elbow Distance / Match Elbow Angle.
• Upgrade TwoElbows45 to support box-select / multi-pair operation.
